ESPN and nflverse have the Jets at 2.5, minus 130 on nflverse's moneyline, with a 39.5 total on ESPN; the ELO Model (52.4 percent) and Broly Model (53.4) agree, the Joker takes Cleveland, and the site's power ratings rank the Jets 31st to Cleveland's 21st.

Protection decides it. 3.0 sacks allowed a game, tied for 25th, and a 10.1 percent sack rate, 31st in the tracker, with Dylan Parham (knee) listed out as of Tuesday; Cleveland gets 3.0 sacks a game, tied for 5th, but Mason Graham is expected to miss the game, per NFL.com and Heavy.

Their own offense works against them. 32 plays in the 23-12 loss in Chicago, a franchise low, with 4 in the first quarter and 0 for 7 on third down, per Yahoo, NBC and SNY; 19.0 points a game, tied for 24th, and 32.0 percent on third down, tied for 28th.
strengths: Geno Smith does not throw interceptions. 85 of 117, 72.6 percent, for 902 yards, 5 touchdowns and none intercepted, per nflverse; he led the league at 75.5 percent through three weeks, per Yahoo and NBC, and said he was fine after getting a little banged up in Chicago.

The defense keeps games close. 21.0 points a game allowed, tied for 11th, and 5.0 yards a play, tied for 6th; the site's ELO Ratings tab ranks the Jets' Total Defense 7th and Cleveland's Total Offense 19th.

They win the turnover battle. Plus 0.8 a game, tied for 4th; Minkah Fitzpatrick had 16 tackles and an interception in Chicago, per ESPN and RotoWire, and Aaron Glenn said penalties wiped out other takeaways, per SNY, Heavy and JetNation.

Garrett Wilson leads a usable passing game. 24 catches for 270 yards and 2 touchdowns, per nflverse; Isaiah Williams caught 2 for 73 and a touchdown in Chicago, per ESPN and nflverse, and Kenyon Sadiq has 12 catches for 143 yards.

Cleveland's best interior rusher is missing. Mason Graham (MCL and ankle sprains) likely misses Weeks 5 and 6, per NFL.com, Heavy and Yardbarker, and the Browns may again be without both Elgton Jenkins and Teven Jenkins inside, listed out on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday.
weaknesses: Three straight losses, and Glenn is on hot seat lists. 20-17 in overtime to Green Bay after leading 17-7, 31-24 at Detroit and 23-12 at Chicago; SportsGrid, Yahoo and PFN list Aaron Glenn, who said the team did not play complementary football, per Heavy, JetNation and SNY.

The pass rush lost Braiden McGregor. A torn pectoral ends his season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter, Yardbarker and SI; Kingsley Enagbare (knee) is listed out as of Tuesday, and the front ranks 30th in pressure rate, 16.6 percent, in the tracker.

The backfield and tight ends are thin. Breece Hall (quad) has been week to week since Week 3 and is listed out as of Tuesday, as are Mason Taylor (thumb) and Adonai Mitchell (finger); Braelon Allen averages 3.6 a carry, and the Jets rank 30th in rush EPA in the tracker.

The secondary is banged up. Jarvis Brownlee Jr. entered the concussion protocol after Chicago, per the Daily News and ESPN's feed, and Tyson Bagent threw for 268 yards on the Jets in his first start since 2023, per the Sun-Times and WGN; the unit ranks 29th in the tracker.

The line is missing Dylan Parham. The guard (knee) did not practice before Week 4 and is listed out as of Tuesday, per ESPN's feed; the Jets rank 30th on the line in the tracker, with 4.0 yards a carry, 25th.
keys: Get the ball out early. Even without Mason Graham, Cleveland pressures 27.1 percent of dropbacks, 7th in the tracker; quick throws to Garrett Wilson protect a line allowing 3.0 sacks a game, tied for 25th, and keep Geno Smith upright.

Stay on the field on third down. 0 for 7 in Chicago and 32.0 percent on the season, tied for 28th; Cleveland ranks 17th in rush EPA allowed in the tracker, so early carries for Braelon Allen can shorten the third downs.

Make Cleveland kick. The Browns score touchdowns on 50 percent of red zone trips, tied for 23rd, and Quinshon Judkins averages 3.0 a carry; Demario Davis and Minkah Fitzpatrick have to hold them to field goals, though Andre Szmyt is 8 of 8.

IND.headline: Jones brings 7 giveaways to Pittsburgh, with Arden Key out and Keenan Allen unsure
matchup: Indianapolis is a 2.5 point road underdog. The total is 44.5 in ESPN's feed and nflverse's lines, an implied 21 to 23.5; the Joker, the Broly Model and the ELO Model all pick Pittsburgh at 55 to 58 percent, after the Colts won 30-13 in London as 3.5 point favorites.

Ball security against T.J. Watt decides it. Daniel Jones has 7 giveaways in four games, 4 interceptions and 3 fumbles lost on sacks, per nflverse; T.J. Watt has 4.5 sacks and Alex Highsmith 3, and Pittsburgh's secondary ranks 3rd in interceptions plus passes defensed per dropback at 18.1 percent in the site's units.

The passing game works against them. 4.5 yards a play, tied for 30th, and 143 passing yards in London, per AP and nflverse; Alec Pierce (heel) is on injured reserve until Week 7 at the earliest, per ESPN and A to Z, and Keenan Allen missed Week 4 with a groin, his Week 5 status still open as of Monday, per The Athletic's James Boyd.
strengths: Jonathan Taylor drives the offense. 353 yards and 6 touchdowns on 86 carries, per nflverse, with 95 yards and 2 scores in London, per AP and ESPN; Indianapolis is 1st in rush EPA a carry at 0.10 in the site's units, against a Pittsburgh run defense 19th in rush EPA allowed that just put Derrick Harmon on injured reserve.

The red zone and the kicker carry a slow offense. 25.5 points a game, 13th, despite 4.5 yards a play; touchdowns on 75 percent of red zone trips, 6th, and Spencer Shrader is 11 for 11 on field goals with a long of 58, per nflverse, after 3 for 3 in London, per ESPN.

The protection has held up. 2 sacks allowed a game, tied for 13th, and a 5.4 percent sack rate, 10th, for a line of Bernhard Raimann, Quenton Nelson, Tanor Bortolini, Matt Goncalves and Jalen Travis; Pittsburgh's front pressures 25.3 percent of dropbacks, 11th.

The defense has improved two weeks running. 17 points to Houston and 13 to Washington after 41 to Baltimore and 33 to Kansas City; DeForest Buckner leads with 3 sacks, per nflverse and Colts.com, and Laiatu Latu had 4 quarterback hits in London, per nflverse.

They play clean. 16 penalties in four games, the fewest in the league at 4 a game, and 1 for 5 yards in London, per nflverse, in a season flagged at a historic rate, per Sharp Football and PFT; Pittsburgh has 25.
weaknesses: Arden Key will miss time. Shane Steichen said Monday the hamstring will keep him out "some time," per The Athletic's James Boyd, and ESPN lists him out; Micheal Clemons (toe) is on injured reserve, per RotoWire and ESPN, thinning the edge rush around Laiatu Latu.

Keenan Allen's groin is unresolved. He was ruled out for London and his Week 5 status was to be determined as of Monday, per The Athletic and ESPN; with Alec Pierce on injured reserve, the targets are Josh Downs (17 catches, 202 yards), Tyler Warren and Laquon Treadwell.

The pass defense leaks. 6.2 yards a play allowed, 31st, and 276.3 passing yards a game, 28th, per nflverse, including 324 to Baltimore and 382 to Kansas City; Pittsburgh hits 4.3 plays of 20 yards a game, 8th, and gains 6.3 yards after the catch, 3rd.

Nothing comes back the other way. 2 takeaways in four games, per nflverse, and minus 1.5 a game in turnover margin, 32nd; Daniel Jones ranks 25th at minus 0.05 EPA a dropback, and Jaylon Carlies's interception in London is the team's only one.

The run defense gives ground. 4.8 yards a carry and 131 rushing yards a game allowed, per nflverse, 28th and 26th; Jaylen Warren is averaging 5.6 a carry, with 127 against Cincinnati and 93 in Cleveland, per AP and ESPN.
keys: Get the ball out against Watt. Daniel Jones has lost 3 fumbles on sacks; quick throws to Tyler Warren, 23 catches on 27 targets, per nflverse, beat a rush with T.J. Watt at 4.5 sacks and Alex Highsmith at 3.

Run Taylor at a front without Harmon. Jonathan Taylor has 86 carries in four games and Indianapolis is 1st in rush EPA a carry in the site's units; Pittsburgh allows 4.3 a carry, per nflverse, and lost Derrick Harmon to injured reserve Monday, per Steelers.com and Steelers Depot.

Make Pittsburgh kick. The Steelers convert 32 percent on third down and 44.4 percent in the red zone, both tied for 28th; keep DK Metcalf, 115 yards in Cleveland, in front of Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward, and Chris Boswell is 7 for 10.

PIT.headline: Rested after Cleveland, but thin at corner with Porter traded and Dean hurt
matchup: Pittsburgh is a 2.5 point home favorite. The total is 44.5, an implied 23.5 to 21; the Joker (57.5 percent), the Broly Model (57.2) and the ELO Model (55.2) pick the Steelers, who lost 27-24 in Cleveland as 2.5 point favorites.

T.J. Watt against Daniel Jones decides it. Watt has 4.5 sacks, per nflverse; Indianapolis is minus 1.5 a game in turnover margin, 32nd, and Jones has 4 interceptions and 3 fumbles lost on sacks, while Pittsburgh is 3rd at 18.1 percent of dropbacks ending in an interception or pass defensed in the site's units.

The cornerback room works against them. Joey Porter Jr. was traded to Dallas, per the Cowboys' site, KDKA and TSN, and Jamel Dean (ankle) is expected to miss a couple of weeks, per Rapoport and Steelers Depot; Sean Murphy-Bunting, signed Monday off Tampa Bay's practice squad, per Steelers.com and PFR, is the new depth.
strengths: They come in rested. 10 days since the Thursday game in Cleveland, against an Indianapolis team on 7 days after the London trip, per nflverse's schedule; Pittsburgh is 14th in the site's power rank, Indianapolis 19th.

The pass rush can swing it. 2.5 sacks a game, tied for 8th, with T.J. Watt at 4.5 and Alex Highsmith at 3, per nflverse; the secondary is 3rd in interceptions plus passes defensed per dropback at 18.1 percent in the site's units, against a quarterback with 7 giveaways.

Rodgers is hitting big plays. 591 yards and 6 touchdowns in the last two games, 292 against Cincinnati and 299 in Cleveland, per AP and NBC; Pittsburgh has 4.3 plays of 20 yards a game, 8th, against a defense allowing 6.2 yards a play, 31st, and DK Metcalf had 5 catches for 115 Thursday.

Jaylen Warren runs well. 309 yards at 5.6 a carry, per nflverse, with 127 against Cincinnati and 93 in Cleveland, per AP and ESPN; Indianapolis allows 4.8 a carry and 131 rushing yards a game, per nflverse.

Rodgers spreads it around. Pat Freiermuth, Darnell Washington and Roman Wilson caught the touchdowns in Cleveland, per ESPN's feed and nflverse; the tight ends have 3 of Aaron Rodgers's 7 touchdown passes, and the receivers rank 8th as a unit.
weaknesses: Joey Porter Jr. is gone and Jamel Dean is hurt. Porter went to Dallas for a 2028 2nd, a 2027 6th and a conditional 6th, per the Cowboys' site, KDKA and TSN; Dean avoided injured reserve but is listed doubtful by ESPN as of Tuesday, leaving Asante Samuel Jr. and Jalen Ramsey, who played Cleveland with a broken wrist, at the top.

Derrick Harmon is on injured reserve. The foot puts the second-year lineman out at least four games, per Steelers.com and Steelers Depot, taking his 1.5 sacks and a forced fumble, per nflverse, off a run defense 19th in rush EPA allowed in the site's units.

Drives stall. 32 percent on third down and 44.4 percent in the red zone, both tied for 28th; no rushing touchdown in four games, per nflverse, and Chris Boswell is 7 for 10 on field goals after going 1 for 2 in Cleveland, per ESPN.

Rodgers takes sacks and threw two picks Thursday. 3.3 sacks allowed a game, tied for 30th, and 5 in Cleveland, per nflverse; Aaron Rodgers ranks 24th at minus 0.04 EPA a dropback and threw 2 interceptions in the loss, per NBC and AP.

Rico Dowdle is uncertain again. The toe cost him Weeks 3 and 4; Mike McCarthy said he had a positive workout Friday and is making progress, but was not sure about the Colts game, per PennLive's Nick Farabaugh and the Fantasy Footballers.
keys: Make Jones put it on the ground. Indianapolis has 8 giveaways in four games, per nflverse; win the edges with T.J. Watt and Alex Highsmith against Bernhard Raimann and Jalen Travis, on a line allowing a 5.4 percent sack rate, 10th, and finish the strip.

Stop Taylor without Harmon. Jonathan Taylor has 6 rushing touchdowns and Indianapolis is 1st in rush EPA a carry in the site's units; Cam Heyward, Keeanu Benton and Patrick Queen have to hold a run defense allowing 4.3 a carry, per nflverse, with Derrick Harmon out.

Protect Rodgers and finish the big plays. Keep the sacks under the 3.3 a game allowed, tied for 30th, against a front pressuring 22.3 percent of dropbacks, 19th, without Arden Key; turn 4.3 explosive plays a game into touchdowns, not Chris Boswell kicks.

NYG.headline: Alone in first, an underdog again, and still looking for a pass rush
matchup: New York is a 3 to 3.5 point road underdog. ESPN's line has moved from 3 to 3.5 with a 43.5 total, an implied 20 to 23.5, and the Giants are plus 150 on the moneyline in nflverse's lines; the Joker, the Broly Model and the ELO Model all pick Washington, from 52.4 to 70.5 percent, but New York is 3-1 against the spread and already beat Dallas and Arizona as an underdog.

The decider is Jameis Winston against a secondary that gives up touchdowns. Washington has allowed 11 touchdown passes, tied with Detroit and Arizona for most, per nflverse, and 30.5 points a game, 30th; Winston threw for 250 yards and 3 touchdowns in the 36-24 win over Arizona, though Washington held Indianapolis to 143 passing yards in London.

Working against them is a front that cannot get home. 3 sacks in four games, 0.8 a game, 32nd, and pressure on 17.1 percent of dropbacks, 29th in the site's unit numbers, against a Washington line allowing 1.3 sacks a game, tied 2nd; Jayden Daniels ran 12 times for 100 yards in his two games, per nflverse.
strengths: The secondary takes the ball away. 6 interceptions, tied with Seattle and Jacksonville for most, per nflverse, and a hand on 19.5 percent of dropbacks, 1st in the site's unit numbers; Jevon Holland has 3 interceptions and 2 forced fumbles, and Deonte Banks, Greg Newsome II and Arvell Reese all picked off Jacoby Brissett in the 36-24 win over Arizona.

Winston finally found the end zone. 18 of 29 for 250 yards and 3 touchdowns against Arizona, per ESPN's feed and nflverse, after none on his first 49 attempts; Malik Nabers (6 for 112), rookie Malachi Fields (2 for 52) and Theo Johnson (11 yards) caught the touchdowns.

The defense keeps scores down. 19.8 points allowed a game, 8th, and 212 passing yards allowed a game, 7th, per nflverse; rookie Arvell Reese leads the team with 33 tackles and Tremaine Edmunds has 32.
Dominic Zvada has not missed. 9 of 9 on field goals this season, per nflverse, including 3 of 3 from 39, 50 and 52 yards against Arizona, per ESPN's feed.

They lead the division and move the chains. Alone in first in the NFC East at 3-1 four games into John Harbaugh's tenure, per Giants.com and NFL.com, already 1-0 in the division after beating Dallas 28-20, and converting 43.4 percent on third down, 9th.
weaknesses: The pass rush ranks last. 3 sacks in four games, 0.8 a game, 32nd, and the front is 32nd in the site's unit grades; Brian Burns (torn ACL) is on injured reserve, per NFL.com and PFT, leaving Abdul Carter (1 sack, 5 quarterback hits) and Kayvon Thibodeaux (no sacks), per nflverse.
The run defense leaks. 4.7 yards a carry allowed, 25th, per nflverse, and last in the site's run defense grade; Arizona ran 26 times for 123 yards in Week 4, and Washington runs for 124 a game, 8th.

The offense lacks big plays and protection. 2 plays of 20 or more yards a game, 31st, and 4.7 yards a play, tied 27th; the line allows an 8.6 percent sack rate, 28th in the site's unit numbers, Arizona sacked Winston 4 times, and Cam Skattebo runs at 3.5 a carry, 235 yards on 68 carries, per nflverse.

Two defenders and a returner are hurt. Safety Jason Pinnock (concussion) and end Chauncey Golston (neck) left the Arizona game and did not return, per ESPN's Jordan Raanan and Giants.com, and were questionable in ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; Braxton Berrios (foot and ankle), doubtful in ESPN's feed as of Tuesday, is headed to injured reserve, per Big Blue View, though Harbaugh said Monday no decision had been made, per the New York Post's Paul Schwartz.

The road has not been kind. Their only road game was a 28-6 loss at the Rams, and the offense scores 20.5 points a game, 21st; Winston completes 55.1 percent this season with 3 interceptions, 2 of them against Arizona, per nflverse.
keys: Keep Daniels in the pocket. He ran 12 times for 100 yards in two games; with the team at 3 sacks all season, Abdul Carter and Kayvon Thibodeaux have to rush with discipline, and Arvell Reese and Tremaine Edmunds have to mirror him on scrambles.

Throw at Washington's secondary early. 11 touchdown passes allowed, tied for most, and 254.5 passing yards allowed a game, 25th, per nflverse; feed Isaiah Likely (team-high 35 targets and 22 catches) and Malik Nabers (team-high 208 yards) before Washington's rush finds Winston.

Win the turnover battle again. The Giants are plus 0.8 a game, tied 4th, and lead the league in hands on the ball in the site's unit numbers; make a quarterback back from two missed games throw into coverage, and keep Winston and Najee Harris (lost fumble against Arizona) from handing Washington short fields.

WAS.headline: Daniels aims to return with Mariota hurt and Lane lost for the season
matchup: Washington is a 3 to 3.5 point home favorite at 1-3. ESPN's line has moved from 3 to 3.5 with a 43.5 total, an implied 23.5 to 20, and Washington is minus 180 in nflverse's lines; the Joker (52.4 percent), the Broly Model (59.2) and the ELO Model (70.5) all pick the Commanders, who sit 27th in the site's power rank to New York's 23rd.

The decider is the run game against the site's lowest-graded front. Washington runs for 124 yards a game, 8th, per nflverse, behind a line 8th in the site's unit grades; New York's front ranks 32nd in those grades, allows 4.7 a carry, 25th, and gave up 123 yards on 26 Arizona carries in Week 4.

Working against them is a thin receiving corps. Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was inactive in London after pushing to play, with Wednesday's practice to be decided, per ESPN's John Keim and the Post, and Jaylin Lane is out for the season; the receivers rank 29th in the unit grades and Washington converts 31.6 percent on third down, 30th.
strengths: Jayden Daniels is aiming to start. Dan Quinn said Monday the plan is a full practice week and a start Sunday, per ESPN, CBS and the Commanders' site; Daniels threw 3 touchdowns with no interceptions and ran 12 times for 100 yards in his two games, per nflverse, before the dislocated left elbow cost him Weeks 3 and 4.

The line keeps the quarterback clean. 1.3 sacks allowed a game, tied 2nd, per TeamRankings, and a 5.3 percent sack rate, 8th in the site's unit numbers; the Giants have 3 sacks in four games, 0.8 a game, 32nd.

They do not turn it over. 2 giveaways in four games, tied for 3rd fewest, per nflverse, and plus 0.8 a game in turnover margin, tied 4th; Daniels and Marcus Mariota have 7 touchdown passes and no interceptions in 102 attempts.

The run game has volume. 124 rushing yards a game, 8th, per nflverse, and 22 carries for 100 yards in London; Rachaad White (shoulder), who averages 4.5 a carry with 9 catches and a receiving touchdown, "should" practice this week, Quinn said Monday, per the Post and RotoWire.

Their one game in Landover was an upset, and they own this series. Washington beat Seattle, now 1st in the site's power rank, 33-31 as an 8.5 point underdog in nflverse's lines, and has won the last four meetings with New York, 21-18 and 27-22 in 2024 and 21-6 and 29-21 last season, per nflverse.
weaknesses: The quarterback room is one injury deep. Mariota sprained his right MCL on the second drive of the 30-13 loss to Indianapolis, timeline uncertain, and was doubtful in ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; Daniels was limited all last week in a brace, so a setback means rookie seventh-round pick Athan Kaliakmanis, 15 of 33 for 186 yards, a touchdown and an interception in London.

Jaylin Lane is out for the season. A fractured and dislocated left ankle; Washington placed him on injured reserve Tuesday, per CBS, Yahoo and the Washington Times, and with McLaurin uncertain, Stefon Diggs (18 for 170 and 3 touchdowns), rookie Antonio Williams (12 for 124) and Treylon Burks carry the group.

The pass defense gives up touchdowns. 11 touchdown passes allowed, tied for most, per nflverse, 30.5 points allowed a game, 30th, and 254.5 passing yards allowed a game, 25th; Indianapolis threw for only 143 yards in London but ran for 3 touchdowns.
The offense stalls. 4.8 yards a play, 26th, and 31.6 percent on third down, 30th; Jacory Croskey-Merritt has 157 yards on 56 carries, 2.8 a carry, and ran 9 times for 15 in London, per nflverse.

The injury list runs through the lineup. Guard Sam Cosmi (concussion) and safety Nick Cross (illness) have missed two straight games, per the official Week 3 and 4 reports, and were listed out in ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; linebacker Leo Chenal is on injured reserve after neck surgery, per Commanders.com and ESPN. Wednesday's official report, due about 4 PM ET, was not out when this was checked.
keys: Run the ball at the Giants. New York allows 4.7 a carry, 25th, and Arizona ran for 123 yards in Week 4; lean on Rachaad White, Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Daniels' legs to keep Winston on the sideline.

Do not feed the ball hawks. The Giants have 6 interceptions, tied for most, and Jevon Holland has 3; Daniels has none in 51 attempts this year and has to keep it that way in his first game since Week 2.

Get after Winston. The Giants allow an 8.6 percent sack rate, 28th in the site's unit numbers, and Arizona sacked him 4 times; Odafe Oweh (2 sacks, 5 quarterback hits) and K'Lavon Chaisson (1.5 sacks, 5 hits) have to beat Andrew Thomas and Jermaine Eluemunor and hurry a passer who threw 2 interceptions against Arizona.

DEN.headline: Favored on the road for the first time this season, likely without Pat Surtain II
matchup: Denver is a 3.5 point road favorite. Minus 185 on the moneyline with a 42.5 total, per ESPN's feed and nflverse, after underdog trips to Kansas City and San Francisco; the Joker, the Broly Model and the ELO Model all take the Broncos, coming off a 24-14 loss at San Francisco.

Zach Allen against the Chargers' patched line decides it. Allen has 3 sacks and 12 quarterback hits, per nflverse; the Chargers allow 3.0 sacks a game, tied for 4th most, per TeamRankings, and lost Rashawn Slater for 4 to 6 weeks, with rookie Logan Taylor moving to left tackle, per Chargers.com, PFT and ESPN.

The run defense works against them. 142.8 rushing yards allowed a game, 29th, and 0.10 EPA allowed a carry, 32nd, per nflverse; San Francisco ran 35 times for 140 on Sunday, and Omarion Hampton brings 238 yards and 3 touchdowns.
strengths: Bo Nix is well protected. 5 sacks in four games, 1.3 a game, tied for 2nd fewest, per TeamRankings, and a 3.6 percent sack rate, 5th, per nflverse; he was not sacked at San Francisco and threw no interceptions, 25 of 42 for 214 yards and a touchdown, per ESPN.

Zach Allen leads a rush that hits the quarterback. 30 quarterback hits, 7.5 a game, 9th, per nflverse, Allen with 12 and Nik Bonitto with 5; the site's unit numbers have Denver 2nd in pressure per dropback at 30.4 percent.

The secondary takes the ball away. 4 interceptions, tied for 4th, per nflverse: Talanoa Hufanga 2, Brandon Jones and Riley Moss 1 each; the site's unit numbers rank the secondary 7th, against a Justin Herbert with 6 interceptions.

Denver has already played four top 10 teams. San Francisco 2nd, Jacksonville 4th, the Rams 7th and Kansas City 10th in the site's power rank, and beat Jacksonville 20-13 and the Rams 30-26; the Chargers lost at home to Arizona and Las Vegas, 29th and 24th.

Drives that get going finish. 39.6 percent on third down, tied for 11th, and touchdowns on 63.6 percent of red zone trips, 11th, per TeamRankings; RJ Harvey caught all 10 of his targets for 68 yards Sunday and Jaylen Waddle leads the team with 185 receiving yards on 16 catches, per nflverse.
weaknesses: Pat Surtain II is expected to miss about two weeks. A non-contact ankle injury at San Francisco, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler, and week to week per the Colorado Springs Gazette and SI; ESPN listed him doubtful and Riley Moss (ribs, imaging Monday per Ian Rapoport) questionable as of Tuesday, leaving Jahdae Barron and Kris Abrams-Draine next on the depth chart.

The run defense is last by EPA. 0.10 EPA allowed a carry, 32nd, 4.8 yards a carry, 26th, and 142.8 yards a game, 29th, per nflverse; Kansas City ran for 220 in Week 1 and San Francisco for 140 on Sunday.

The offense lacks big plays and a run game. 18.5 points a game, 27th, per TeamRankings, 2.5 plays of 20 or more yards a game, tied for 29th, per ESPN, and 3.6 yards a carry, 26th, per nflverse; Courtland Sutton has 9 catches on 22 targets for 86 yards, and 1 catch for 4 yards on six targets Sunday.

Road games have gone badly. 0-2 away, 31-10 at Kansas City and 24-14 at San Francisco, and 0-2 at SoFi under Bo Nix, 34-27 in 2024 and 23-20 in 2025, per nflverse; Jim Harbaugh is 3-1 against Sean Payton.

Special teams and depth are leaking. Marvin Mims Jr.'s muffed punt set up the 49ers' go-ahead touchdown, per AP and PFT, and Wil Lutz is 5 for 7 on field goals, with a miss from 58 at San Francisco, per nflverse; Pat Bryant (ankle) was listed doubtful as of Tuesday despite a good MRI, per Rapoport and ESPN, and Dondrea Tillman (hamstring) was listed out.
keys: Make the rookies block Zach Allen. Line him up over the rookies filling in for Rashawn Slater and Joe Alt; the Chargers allow 3.0 sacks a game, tied for 4th most, and committed 16 penalties for 130 yards at Seattle, per nflverse.

Stop Omarion Hampton before anything else. 238 yards and 3 touchdowns on 59 carries, and the Chargers ran 32 times for 147 at Seattle, per nflverse; Denver allows 142.8 rushing yards a game, 29th, and third and long is where this pass rush wins.

Take the ball when Herbert offers it. The Chargers have 10 giveaways, 4 of them at Seattle; Denver had no takeaway at San Francisco after 4 interceptions in the first three games, Talanoa Hufanga with 2, per nflverse.

LAC.headline: 0-4, Rashawn Slater out for weeks, and Harbaugh calls it a one-game season
matchup: Los Angeles is a 3.5 point home underdog. Plus 154 on the moneyline with a 42.5 total in ESPN's feed and nflverse's lines, an implied 19.5 to 23; the site's three models all take Denver, after the Chargers lost 30-23 at Seattle, exactly the 7 point line.

A line of rookies against Zach Allen decides it. Rashawn Slater is out 4 to 6 weeks with a high ankle sprain, per Rapoport, and rookie Logan Taylor moved to left tackle, per Chargers.com and PFT; Joe Alt (neck) is still being evaluated, per Chargers.com, and was listed questionable as of Tuesday, per ESPN, against Allen's 12 quarterback hits.

Giveaways and flags work against them. 10 giveaways, 6 interceptions and 4 lost fumbles, and minus 0.8 a game in turnover margin, tied for 24th, per TeamRankings; 38 penalties, 9.5 a game and 4th most, including 16 for 130 yards at Seattle, per nflverse.
strengths: The run game can attack Denver's weak spot. Omarion Hampton has 238 yards and 3 touchdowns, and the Chargers run for 121.5 yards a game, 9th, with 147 on 32 carries at Seattle, per nflverse; Denver allows 0.10 EPA a carry, 32nd.

The run defense holds. 3.8 yards a carry allowed, 10th, and minus 0.12 EPA a carry, 8th, per nflverse, and the site's unit numbers rank the front 3rd; Denver runs for 3.6 a carry, 26th, with J.K. Dobbins at 3.5.

Khalil Mack and Tuli Tuipulotu get home. Mack has 3 sacks and 5 tackles for loss, Tuipulotu 2 sacks, 7 quarterback hits, an interception and a forced fumble; the Chargers hit the quarterback on 25.8 percent of dropbacks, 3rd, per nflverse.

Harbaugh and Herbert own this series. 3-0 against Sean Payton and Bo Nix with Justin Herbert starting: 23-16 in Denver and 34-27 at SoFi in 2024, 23-20 at SoFi last September; the one loss, 19-3 in Denver in Week 18 last season, came with Trey Lance at quarterback, per nflverse.

The offense found points in Seattle. A season high 23, with Cameron Dicker 3 for 3 on field goals and Tre Harris catching 3 for 60, per ESPN and nflverse, helped by Seattle's seven personal fouls, four on Chargers scoring drives, per ESPN and the Spokesman-Review; Harris leads with 13 catches for 209 yards.
weaknesses: The offensive line is in pieces. Rashawn Slater (high ankle, 4 to 6 weeks) is "more of a possibility for IR" than Joe Alt (neck), Jim Harbaugh said Monday, per Chargers.com and PFT; guard Trevor Penning (concussion) was listed questionable and Kayode Awosika (leg) out as of Tuesday, per ESPN, and Trey Pipkins III and Tyler Biadasz are on injured reserve, per the league roster feed.

Justin Herbert keeps turning it over. 59.7 percent, 816 yards, 4 touchdowns and 6 interceptions, tied for 2nd most, a 70.6 rating and 12 sacks, tied for 3rd most, per nflverse; at Seattle he threw 2 interceptions and lost a fumble, per ESPN.

Derwin James and Ladd McConkey are week to week. James (hamstring) was inactive at Seattle and McConkey (foot) caught 0 of 2 targets there, both week to week per Harbaugh, per BoltBeat and Chargers.com; Dalvin Tomlinson (hamstring) and Brenen Thompson (quad) were listed out and Donte Jackson (hamstring) questionable as of Tuesday, per ESPN.

The offense cannot score. 16.8 points a game, 29th, and 34.6 percent on third down, tied for 22nd, per TeamRankings; home losses of 26-14 to Arizona and 26-14 to Las Vegas, 29th and 24th in the site's power rank.

The season is slipping away. 0-4, every loss by 7 points or more, and 0-3-1 against the spread, per nflverse; Harbaugh is 2nd on post-Week 4 hot seat lists, per SportsGrid and Yahoo, and the next trip is to Kansas City, coming off its bye.
keys: Run Omarion Hampton 25 times. Denver allows 142.8 rushing yards a game, 29th, and San Francisco beat it with 35 carries Sunday; a steady run game keeps a rookie line out of third and long against Zach Allen.

Protect the ball. 10 giveaways in four games, 4 at Seattle; Denver has 4 interceptions, Talanoa Hufanga with 2, and only 5 giveaways of its own, per nflverse, so this offense cannot spot it a short field.

Throw at the corners behind Pat Surtain II. If Surtain (doubtful) and Riley Moss (questionable) sit, Tre Harris (13 catches, 209 yards) and Quentin Johnston get Jahdae Barron and Kris Abrams-Draine; quick throws to Oronde Gadsden II also beat the rush.

DET.headline: Goff has not thrown a pick; the secondary keeps giving up the big one
matchup: Detroit is a 4.5 to 5.5 point road favorite, total 54.5. ESPN's line is 4.5 and nflverse's 5.5, with the Lions minus 258 on the moneyline; the ELO Model, the Joker and the Broly Model all pick Detroit, from 68.9 to 81.7 percent.

The decider is Goff against a pass defense ranked 31st. Jared Goff ranks 3rd in the site's unit numbers at 0.23 EPA a dropback and has 9 touchdowns and no interceptions, per nflverse; in the same numbers Arizona allows 0.23 EPA a dropback, 31st, and pressures 19.2 percent of dropbacks, 26th, which leaves time for Amon-Ra St. Brown (31 catches, 303 yards, 5 touchdowns).

What works against them is the secondary. Detroit allows 327 passing yards a game, 32nd, and 31.8 points a game, 31st, per nflverse and the site's stats; Rock Ya-Sin (hamstring) is expected to miss Sunday, per The Detroit News, and was doubtful on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday.
strengths: Goff has not thrown an interception. 109 of 161, 67.7 percent, for 1,214 yards and 9 touchdowns, per nflverse, including 32 of 52 for 412 yards at Carolina, per ESPN's feed; Detroit passes for 303.5 yards a game, 2nd.

The offense scores every week. 29.8 points a game, 5th, with touchdowns on 72.2 percent of red zone trips, 8th, and 26 or more in all four games; Jake Bates is 7 of 7 on field goals, 4 of 4 at Carolina, per nflverse and ESPN's feed.

The pass rush ranks 2nd in sacks. 3.8 a game, 15 in all, with Aidan Hutchinson at 3.5 and 9 quarterback hits and D.J. Wonnum and Alim McNeill at 3 each, per nflverse; pressure on 26.5 percent of dropbacks ranks 9th.

Goff has more than one answer. Jahmyr Gibbs has 7 touchdowns, per Lions.com and nflverse, 5 rushing and 2 receiving, with 540 scrimmage yards; Sam LaPorta caught 8 for 84 and a touchdown at Carolina and Jameson Williams 6 for 102, per ESPN's feed.

They protect the ball and the passer. 1 giveaway in four games, tied with the Jets for the fewest, per nflverse, plus 0.8 a game in turnover margin, tied 4th, and a 5.5 percent sack rate allowed, 11th in the site's unit numbers; Goff was sacked once in 53 dropbacks at Carolina, and Arizona gets 2 sacks a game, tied 16th.
weaknesses: The pass defense ranks last. 327 passing yards a game, 32nd, 20 completions of 20 or more yards, the most, and 11 touchdown passes, tied for the most, per nflverse; the secondary ranks 27th at 0.15 EPA allowed a dropback.

Carolina just shredded it. Bryce Young threw for 329 yards and 2 touchdowns without a turnover and Tetairoa McMillan had a career high 192 yards on 14 catches, per ESPN, Panthers.com and nflverse; Detroit has allowed 30 or more in three of four games.

The back end is down to depth. Rock Ya-Sin (hamstring) is expected to miss Sunday, per The Detroit News, and was doubtful on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; safeties Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch (Achilles) are on PUP and Avonte Maddox and Thomas Harper (ankle) on injured reserve, per the Free Press and nflverse's roster.

The run game disappeared at Carolina. 15 carries for 46 yards, all by Gibbs, per ESPN's feed and nflverse, while Carolina ran 28 times for 127; Detroit runs for 102 yards a game, 20th, and allows 119.8, 21st.

Detroit is 0-2 on the road. It lost 41-31 at Buffalo and 32-26 at Carolina; guard Ben Bartch (foot) has missed two straight games, per the official reports, and center Cade Mays (wrist) is on injured reserve with a Week 7 target, per the Free Press.
keys: Throw early at the 31st ranked pass defense. Arizona allows 0.23 EPA a dropback and 11 touchdown passes, tied for most; Goff, St. Brown and LaPorta face safeties with Andrew Wingard (knee) questionable and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (back) out on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday.

Make the rookie left tackle block Hutchinson. Jayden Williams replaces Paris Johnson Jr. on a line ranked 18th in the site's unit grades; Hutchinson and a rush with 3.8 sacks a game, 2nd, can push Jacoby Brissett, who threw 3 interceptions at New York, into more mistakes.

Keep everything in front of the secondary. Arizona has 4 completions of 20 or more yards all season, the fewest, per nflverse; with Ya-Sin out, the corners and safeties Chuck Clark and Christian Izien have to tackle Trey McBride and Michael Wilson short and make the Cardinals drive the length of the field.

ARI.headline: A rookie at left tackle, Love's ankle hurting again, and a share of the week's top total
matchup: Arizona is a 4.5 to 5.5 point home underdog, total 54.5. ESPN's line is 4.5 and nflverse's 5.5, with the Cardinals plus 210; the ELO Model, the Joker and the Broly Model give Arizona 18.3 to 31.1 percent, and the site's power rank has it 29th to Detroit's 13th.

The decider is protecting Brissett with a rookie at left tackle. Paris Johnson Jr. tore his biceps at New York and is out for the season, the third straight year his season has ended early, so Jayden Williams starts, per Cardinals.com and Arizona Sports; Detroit's 3.8 sacks a game rank 2nd.

What works against them is the lack of big plays. 4 completions of 20 or more yards in four games, the fewest, per nflverse, and 1.3 explosive plays a game, 32nd; Arizona gains 4.5 yards a play, tied 30th, against an offense scoring 29.8 a game, 5th.
strengths: Detroit's pass defense is the softest in the league. The Lions allow 327 passing yards a game, 32nd, and 20 completions of 20 or more yards, the most, per nflverse, and expect to be without Rock Ya-Sin (hamstring), per The Detroit News; Trey McBride leads Arizona with 33 catches and Michael Wilson caught 7 for 95 at New York, per ESPN's feed.

The run defense is efficient. The front ranks 10th in the site's unit grades and 3rd in rush EPA allowed at minus 0.11 a carry; Detroit ran 15 times for 46 yards at Carolina, per ESPN's feed and nflverse.

Takeaways keep them in games. Plus 0.8 a game in turnover margin, tied 4th, with a hand on 16.4 percent of dropbacks, 7th; Budda Baker and Denzel Burke intercepted Jameis Winston in Week 4, per nflverse and ESPN's feed.

The pass rush finally got home. 4 sacks of Winston, one each by Josh Sweat, Zaven Collins, Walter Nolen III and Darius Robinson, per nflverse, after 4 in the first three games; Arizona ran 26 times for 123 yards in the same game.

They score more than the yardage says. 21.8 points a game, 17th, despite 4.5 yards a play, tied 30th; Arizona has scored 24 or more in three of four games and Chad Ryland is 8 of 9 on field goals, per nflverse.
weaknesses: Paris Johnson Jr. is out for the season. A torn biceps at New York, per Cardinals.com, Arizona Sports and Newsweek; rookie Jayden Williams moves to left tackle, and Arizona is adding Jedrick Wills Jr., the No. 10 pick in 2020, off Buffalo's practice squad, per Arizona Sports and NFL.com.

Jeremiyah Love's ankle is hurting again. He tweaked his other ankle at New York, not the one he sprained in August, and is expected to sit this week, per Cardinals.com, NBC and Arizona Sports, though ESPN's feed still listed him questionable as of Tuesday; he leads the team with 223 rushing yards, and Tyler Allgeier averages 3.5 a carry, per nflverse.

Brissett handed the Giants the game. 21 of 35 for 166 yards, 2 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in the 36-24 loss at New York, one returned 98 yards by Deonte Banks, per ESPN's feed and Giants.com; Jacoby Brissett averages 5.4 yards an attempt and ranks 22nd at minus 0.02 EPA a dropback in the site's unit numbers.

The defense leaks too. 29.3 points a game allowed, 29th, 6.1 yards a play allowed, 30th, and 0.23 EPA a dropback allowed, 31st; Arizona has allowed 36 points in each of its last two games and lost its only home game 31-7 to Seattle.

The secondary and the line are banged up. Safety Andrew Wingard (knee bone bruise, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler) and guard Isaiah Adams (ankle, per the Arizona Republic's Theo Mackie) were hurt at New York and were questionable on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; safety Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (back) has missed two straight games, per the official reports.
keys: Get the ball out fast. With a rookie at left tackle against a rush with 3.8 sacks a game, 2nd, quick throws to Trey McBride (33 catches) and Michael Wilson (25 for 258) keep Brissett upright; Arizona allows 1.8 sacks a game, tied 10th fewest.

Take shots at the Lions' secondary. Detroit has allowed 20 completions of 20 or more yards, the most, and Rock Ya-Sin is expected out; an offense with 4 such completions all season needs Marvin Harrison Jr. (5 catches on 13 targets) involved to keep pace with a 54.5 total.

Force the first Goff interception. Jared Goff has none in 161 attempts, per nflverse, but Arizona gets a hand on 16.4 percent of dropbacks, 7th, and picked off Jameis Winston twice last week; short fields are the surest points against a top 5 scoring offense.

SF.headline: Unbeaten and unsacked, with Bosa unlikely, on a first true road trip to Seattle
matchup: San Francisco is a 2.5 to 3 point road underdog. Plus 130 on the moneyline, per nflverse, after a 24-14 win over Denver that made it 4-0; the Joker (50.7 percent) and the ELO Model (51.6) take the 49ers, the Broly Model (55.0) takes Seattle.

The deciding matchup is the line against Seattle's rush. 0 sacks on 113 pass attempts, the only team at zero, per TeamRankings and nflverse, against a Seattle front with 11 sacks, 7th, and pressure on 28.5 percent of dropbacks, 4th, in the site's unit numbers; Leonard Williams has 3 sacks and 6 quarterback hits, Derick Hall 2 and 6.

History and the injury list work against them. Seattle won the last two meetings 13-3 and 41-6, the second in the divisional round at Lumen Field, per nflverse; this is San Francisco's first true road game after Melbourne and three home games, and Nick Bosa, James Thompson Jr., Marques Sigle and Kyle Juszczyk are expected out.
strengths: Brock Purdy is the league's most efficient passer. 79 of 113 for 1,007 yards, 11 touchdowns, tied for 1st, and 1 interception, a 126.2 passer rating, 1st among qualifiers, per nflverse; the site's unit numbers have him 1st at 0.33 EPA a dropback. He went 19 of 30 for 218 yards and 2 touchdowns against Denver.

Nobody has sacked Purdy. 0 sacks in four games, per TeamRankings, nflverse and NBC Sports Bay Area, and Denver's rush, 2nd in pressure rate in the site's unit numbers, did not get him Sunday; entering Week 4, PFT and SI noted no team had gone three games without allowing a sack in 12 years.

Drives end in touchdowns. 57.5 percent on third down and 84.6 percent touchdowns in the red zone, both 1st, and 30.5 points a game, tied for 2nd, per TeamRankings; George Kittle has 4 touchdown catches, tied for 3rd, including a 56 yard screen with 2:15 left Sunday, per AP and PFT.

The defense does not give up big plays. 1.5 plays of 20 or more yards allowed a game, 2nd fewest, and no runs of 20 or more, per nflverse; 16.0 points a game allowed, 3rd, and 4.8 yards a play, 3rd, per TeamRankings, against a Seattle offense averaging 3.8 explosive plays a game, tied for 11th.

They do not beat themselves. 17 accepted penalties, 2nd fewest, and 1 for 5 yards against Denver, plus 2 giveaways, tied for 3rd fewest, per nflverse; Seattle was flagged 14 times for 150 yards Sunday.
weaknesses: Nick Bosa and James Thompson Jr. are not expected to play. Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Bosa is unlikely and Thompson (ankle) is not expected back, per the Mercury News and ESPN; both missed Weeks 3 and 4, and Bosa has no sacks in the two games he played, per nflverse.

The pass rush has gone quiet. 6 sacks, 1.5 a game, tied for 26th, per TeamRankings, none against Denver, and a 15.1 percent pressure rate, 32nd, in the site's unit numbers; Keion White leads with 2 sacks, per nflverse.

The secondary loses Marques Sigle. The starting strong safety, 26 tackles and a sack, is out multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, per The Athletic's Matt Barrows and ESPN; Malik Mustapha is next on ESPN's depth chart, and the defense has 1 interception, tied for 25th, per nflverse.

Kyle Juszczyk is out for weeks. A hyperextended right knee with a bone bruise, 2 to 3 weeks per ESPN and several weeks per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport; the fullback has 4 catches for 55 yards and a touchdown and leads the way for Christian McCaffrey.

Seattle has owned the recent meetings. 13-3 at Levi's Stadium in Week 18 and 41-6 at Lumen Field in the divisional round, with Brock Purdy 34 of 54 for 267 yards, 0 touchdowns, 2 interceptions and 5 sacks across the two, per nflverse.
keys: Keep Purdy upright against Seattle's rush. 0 sacks in four games, but Derick Hall, DeMarcus Lawrence, Leonard Williams, Jarran Reed and Uchenna Nwosu each sacked him in the last two meetings. Trent Williams and Colton McKivitz have to hold the edges, and Leonard Williams (ankle) is expected to play, per the Seattle Times.

Lean on Christian McCaffrey to stay ahead of the chains. 35 carries for 140 yards against Denver, and McCaffrey has 218 rushing yards, 4 touchdowns and 16 catches, per nflverse; the 49ers convert 57.5 percent on third down, 1st, against a defense allowing 3.6 yards a carry, 7th.

Take away Jaxon Smith-Njigba without Sigle. 32 catches, 481 yards and 6 touchdowns, per nflverse; Renardo Green, Deommodore Lenoir and Upton Stout have to keep the 1.5 explosive plays a game allowed, 2nd fewest, with a rush that had no sacks against Denver.

SEA.headline: The champions, 41-6 winners in January, host the unbeaten 49ers after a 150 yard penalty day
matchup: Seattle is a 2.5 to 3 point home favorite. Minus 155 on the moneyline with a 46.5 to 47.5 total, per ESPN and nflverse, after a 30-23 win over the Chargers; the Broly Model takes Seattle at 55.0 percent, the Joker and the ELO Model take San Francisco, and the site's power rank has Seattle 1st, one spot ahead.

The deciding matchup is Seattle's rush against a line that has not allowed a sack. 11 sacks, 2.8 a game, 7th, per TeamRankings, and pressure on 28.5 percent of dropbacks, 4th, in the site's unit numbers; Leonard Williams (ankle) is expected to play, per Mike Macdonald to the Seattle Times, against a 49ers line with 0 sacks allowed in four games.

Third down and the run game work against them. 31.1 percent on third down, 31st, per TeamRankings, and minus 0.12 rush EPA a carry, 29th, in the site's unit numbers; Jadarian Price is on injured reserve and Zach Charbonnet will not come off PUP this week, per ESPN and the News Tribune.
strengths: The defense allows the fewest yards per play. 4.0 a play, 1st, and 18.3 points a game, 5th, per TeamRankings; 161.3 passing yards a game allowed, 2nd, and 5.2 yards an attempt, 2nd, per nflverse, against Brock Purdy at 8.9 yards an attempt, 2nd.

The defense takes the ball away. 6 interceptions, tied for 1st, and 8 takeaways, tied for 2nd, per nflverse, 4 of them against the Chargers Sunday; Julian Love has 2 interceptions, and Ernest Jones IV and Drake Thomas each picked off Justin Herbert.

The front stops the run. Minus 0.15 rush EPA allowed a carry, 1st, in the site's unit numbers, and 3.6 yards a carry, 7th, per nflverse, against Christian McCaffrey at 4.4; in January's 41-6 playoff win he ran 11 times for 35.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads an efficient passing game. 32 catches for 481 yards, 3rd, and 6 touchdowns, 1st, per nflverse; Sam Darnold averages 8.1 yards an attempt, 4th among qualifiers, and went 13 of 22 for 168 yards and 2 touchdowns against the Chargers.

Lumen Field has been their edge. 2-0 at home this season and 9 straight wins at Lumen Field since October 2025, including the 41-6 divisional round win over San Francisco, per nflverse; this is the 49ers' first true road game of 2026.
weaknesses: The penalties have to stop. 14 for a franchise record 150 yards against the Chargers, seven of them personal fouls, four of those on Chargers scoring drives, per ESPN and the Spokesman-Review, and Mike Macdonald called it "unacceptable on any level"; 35 accepted penalties for 327 yards, 3rd most, to San Francisco's 17 for 173, per nflverse.

The backfield that ran over San Francisco in January is gone. Kenneth Walker III, 116 yards and 3 touchdowns in the 41-6 playoff win, now plays for Kansas City; rookie first round pick Jadarian Price (chest) went on injured reserve Saturday and Zach Charbonnet (ACL) stays on PUP, per ESPN, the News Tribune and NBC. Emanuel Wilson averages 3.6 a carry, per nflverse.

Third downs stall drives. 31.1 percent, 31st, and touchdowns on 56.3 percent of red zone trips, 17th, per TeamRankings, against a 49ers offense converting 57.5 percent on third down and 84.6 percent in the red zone, both 1st.

Seattle gives the ball away more than San Francisco. 5 giveaways, tied for 13th fewest, to the 49ers' 2; Sam Darnold has 3 interceptions in 69 attempts, 2 in the 33-31 loss at Washington that ended a 12 game winning streak, and Jadarian Price, now on injured reserve, lost 2 fumbles, per nflverse and ESPN.

The injury list touches every level. Leonard Williams (ankle) is expected to play but was listed questionable as of Tuesday; safety Ty Okada (hamstring), who has not played this season, and linebacker Chazz Surratt (calf) are listed out, per ESPN's injury feed, and Seattle plays at Denver four days later.
keys: Get Brock Purdy on the ground. 0 sacks allowed in four games, but Derick Hall, DeMarcus Lawrence, Leonard Williams, Jarran Reed and Uchenna Nwosu each sacked him in the last two meetings, when he threw 0 touchdowns; Seattle's 11 sacks rank 7th.

Feed Jaxon Smith-Njigba against a rush without Nick Bosa. San Francisco pressures 15.1 percent of dropbacks, 32nd, in the site's unit numbers, and loses safety Marques Sigle; Smith-Njigba has 6 touchdown catches and Sam Darnold averages 8.1 yards an attempt.

Play clean and win the turnover battle. Four of the seven personal fouls against the Chargers came on their scoring drives; San Francisco had 1 penalty Sunday and has 2 giveaways all season, so Seattle's 8 takeaways, tied for 2nd, and Julian Love's 2 interceptions have to show up.

BAL.headline: Lamar Jackson's ankle likely hands Tyler Huntley a Sunday night start against the league's best run defense
matchup: Baltimore is a 3.5 point underdog, the first time it has not been favored this season. The line moved from 1.5 to 3 on ESPN's feed Tuesday and to 3.5 on nflverse Wednesday, total 43.5; the site's Joker and Broly Model take Atlanta, while the ELO Model takes Baltimore at 63.3 percent with Lamar Jackson still in its lineup.

The deciding matchup is Derrick Henry against Atlanta's run front. Henry has 374 yards and 7 touchdowns at 4.2 a carry, but the Falcons allow 48.3 rushing yards a game and 2.7 a carry, both 1st per nflverse, and no opponent has topped 68 rushing yards against them; Green Bay ran 9 times for 17.

What works against them is the quarterback spot and the injury list. Jackson has only an outside chance to play, per Rapoport, ESPN and CBS, so Tyler Huntley would make his first start of the season; Trey Hendrickson (finger) is listed out and Marlon Humphrey (calf), Andrew Vorhees (foot) and Ronnie Stanley (toe) questionable on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday.
strengths: The offense is 2nd in yards per play. 6.6 a play and 29.0 points a game, 7th, with 4.8 explosive plays a game, tied for 3rd, per the site's stats; Baltimore runs for 153.5 yards a game, 4th per nflverse, and scored 41 at Indianapolis and 34 against Dallas.

Derrick Henry finishes drives. 7 rushing touchdowns on 89 carries, per nflverse, after leading the league with 6 through three weeks, per NFL.com; Baltimore scores touchdowns on 73.3 percent of red zone trips, 7th.

They take care of the ball. Plus 0.8 a game in turnover margin, tied for 4th, with 2 giveaways in four games, per the site's stats and nflverse; Trenton Simpson intercepted Cam Ward and Kyle Hamilton forced a fumble in the 24-18 win over Tennessee.

Zay Flowers played through the hamstring and produced. Questionable and limited last week, then 8 catches for 118 yards and a touchdown against Tennessee, per nflverse and ESPN's feed; he has 352 yards on 18 catches in three games, against a Falcons pass defense allowing 276.5 yards a game, 29th.

The pass defense keeps throws out of the end zone. 4 passing touchdowns allowed, tied for 3rd fewest, per nflverse, after a 2.9 percent touchdown rate, 6th, through three weeks per Sharp; Michael Penix Jr. has 2 touchdown passes in two starts.
weaknesses: Lamar Jackson probably does not play. He hurt the ankle in the 24-18 win over Tennessee and Tyler Huntley played the second half; it is a sprain of a rarer type, neither low nor high, with only an outside chance for Sunday and a chance he misses multiple games, per Rapoport, ESPN, CBS and NBC, though Jesse Minter does not think it is crazy long term.

The pass rush is thin without Trey Hendrickson. He had a finger procedure Oct 2 after playing two games with a fracture, per NFL.com and Baltimore Beatdown, and is listed out on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; Baltimore has 1.8 sacks a game, tied for 22nd, and pressures on 21.5 percent of dropbacks, 22nd in the site's units.

The line and the secondary are banged up. Marlon Humphrey (calf) and Andrew Vorhees (foot) left Sunday and Ronnie Stanley (toe) finished it, per the Banner and the Sun, all questionable on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday; rookie Olaivavega Ioane is at center with Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn on injured reserve. On Wednesday Baltimore traded a 2027 5th and a 2028 2nd to Philadelphia for interior lineman Cam Jurgens and a 2027 7th, per the Inquirer and Pro Football Rumors, but Jurgens has been in the concussion protocol since Monday, per PFT and NBC Sports Philadelphia.

Durham Smythe is out for the season. A torn Achilles for a tight end who played 50 percent of the offensive snaps, per Newsweek, Yahoo and Heavy; rookie Matthew Hibner (5 catches, 70 yards, 1 touchdown) moves up behind Mark Andrews.

Third downs and flags stall drives. 32.4 percent on third down, 27th, per the site's stats, and 39 penalties for 329 yards, 2nd most yards, per nflverse, including 13 for 131 against Tennessee; the secondary ranks 26th in the site's units, allowing 0.09 EPA a dropback, 22nd.
keys: Get the ball out fast for Huntley. Atlanta has 38 quarterback hits, 2nd per nflverse, but only 1.8 sacks a game, tied for 22nd; quick throws to Mark Andrews, a team high 24 targets, and Zay Flowers keep Baltimore ahead of the chains, and it converts only 32.4 percent of third downs, 27th.

Attack the left tackle spot. Jake Matthews (groin) left Monday in the 1st quarter and is questionable as of Tuesday, with Michael Jerrell the fill in; aim Tavius Robinson, 2 sacks and 6 quarterback hits, and Mike Green at that side.

Stop Bijan Robinson before Penix gets comfortable. Atlanta ran for 447 yards in Penix's two starts and Bijan Robinson is at 5.8 a carry, per nflverse; Roquan Smith (34 tackles) and Kyle Hamilton (3 tackles for loss) have to fit a run defense that gave Dallas 148 yards in Rio.

ATL.headline: Two road wins at 40 a game, favored for the first time, and sole first place in the NFC South on offer
matchup: Atlanta is a 3.5 point home favorite, its first time favored this season. The line moved from 1.5 Tuesday morning to 3 Tuesday afternoon on ESPN's feed and 3.5 on nflverse Wednesday, minus 175 on the moneyline; the site's Joker (62.2 percent) and Broly Model (61.5) take Atlanta, while the ELO Model takes Baltimore.

The deciding matchup is Bijan Robinson against Roquan Smith's front. Atlanta runs for 181 yards a game at 5.2 a carry, both 2nd per nflverse; Baltimore allows 100 rushing yards a game, 10th, and 3.9 a carry, 11th, and Smith leads it with 34 tackles.

What works against them is the injury list on the edges. Jake Matthews (groin) left in the 1st quarter of his 200th Falcons start and Za'Darius Smith (concussion), the team leader with 2.5 sacks, also left Monday, per Yahoo, SI and the Falcons' site; both are questionable on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday, on six days' rest.
strengths: Michael Penix Jr. changed the offense. 33 of 45 for 479 yards, 2 touchdowns and 1 interception in two starts, capped by 15 of 20 for 223 in the 45-24 win at New Orleans, per nflverse and ESPN's feed; Atlanta has scored 40 a game since his return, per NFL.com, AP and CBS, after 16 points in two games without him.

The run game is 2nd in the league. 181 yards a game at 5.2 a carry, per nflverse, and 205 at New Orleans, per AP and Fox; Bijan Robinson has 494 yards at 5.8 a carry, and Brian Robinson Jr. ran for 3 touchdowns Monday, per NFL.com and ESPN's feed.

The run defense is the league's best. 48.3 rushing yards a game and 2.7 a carry allowed, both 1st, and no run of 20 yards, per nflverse; Fox had it at 47.7 a game through three weeks, and Green Bay and New Orleans ran for 67 yards between them.

Drake London is the big play. 20 catches for 370 yards, 18.5 a catch, per nflverse, including 9 for 194 at Green Bay, per ESPN and the AJC; the receivers are 1st in yards after the catch per catch in the site's units, against a Baltimore secondary 26th.

The pressure keeps coming. 38 quarterback hits, 2nd per nflverse, 12 in each of the last two games; Cameron Thomas has 8 hits and Samson Ebukam 7, with 1.5 sacks each, against a Ravens line with a rookie center and two starters questionable.
weaknesses: Jake Matthews and Za'Darius Smith are hurt. Matthews (groin) left in the 1st quarter Monday with an MRI pending and Michael Jerrell finished at left tackle; Smith (concussion) left with a team high 2.5 sacks; both questionable on ESPN's feed as of Tuesday, per Yahoo, SI, Heavy and the Falcons' site.

The pass defense gives up yards. 276.5 passing yards a game, 29th, per nflverse, after 263 through three weeks per Fox; A.J. Terrell (groin) is on injured reserve, so C.J. Henderson starts, with 6 passes defended.
The turnover margin is still minus 5. Minus 1.3 a game, tied for 27th, per the site's stats, with 3 takeaways in four games, per nflverse; Baltimore is plus 0.8 a game, tied for 4th.

Edge depth is thin. James Pearce Jr. is serving an eight game suspension and Jalon Walker has been on injured reserve since the opener, per Yahoo, NBC Miami and nflverse's rosters; Atlanta has 1.8 sacks a game, tied for 22nd, despite all the hits.

The passing game is low volume and home has not been kind. 191.8 passing yards a game, 25th, and 3 passing touchdowns, tied for 28th, per nflverse; the only home game was a 34-3 loss to Carolina in Week 2.
keys: Keep the ball with Bijan Robinson. He is at 5.8 a carry and Atlanta ran for 447 yards in Penix's two starts, per nflverse; Baltimore gave Dallas 148 rushing yards in Rio and allows 100 a game, 10th.

Make Tyler Huntley beat the coverage. If Lamar Jackson sits, crowd the box against Derrick Henry, 4.2 a carry, and turn a front with 38 quarterback hits, 2nd, loose on a backup; Baltimore converts 32.4 percent of third downs, 27th.

Take shots to Drake London. London averages 18.5 a catch and the receivers lead the site's units in yards after the catch; Baltimore's secondary is 26th, and Marlon Humphrey (calf) is questionable as of Tuesday.

BUF.headline: Off the first loss under Brady, with Moore, Oliver and Benford banged up
matchup: Buffalo is a 2.5 to 3 point underdog. ESPN lists the Rams by 2.5 and nflverse by 3 with a 54.5 total, tied for the week's highest, and the Bills at plus 136; the Broly Model, the Joker and the ELO Model all take the Rams, but the power ratings rank Buffalo 3rd and Los Angeles 7th.

The deciding matchup is Allen against the Rams' secondary. Josh Allen is 4th in EPA a dropback at 0.22, and 13.3 percent of Buffalo's throws gain 20 yards, 1st; the Rams allow minus 0.09 EPA a dropback, 3rd, with Trent McDuffie, Quentin Lake and Kam Curl leading a secondary ranked 1st in the tracker.

What works against them is the defense. New England scored 29 in Sunday's 29-26 loss, the first under Joe Brady; Buffalo allows 26.8 points a game, 25th, and 372.2 yards, 27th, per nflverse, and its run defense ranks 32nd in rush EPA allowed.
strengths: The offense leads the league. 31.8 points a game, 1st, 6.5 yards a play, tied 3rd, 53.3 percent on third down, 2nd, and 5.5 plays of 20 or more yards a game, 1st, in the tracker's numbers; 13.3 percent of throws gain 20 yards, also 1st.

Josh Allen is scoring both ways. 79 of 119 for 1,039 yards, 6 touchdowns and 3 interceptions, plus 7 rushing touchdowns, tied with Derrick Henry for the league lead, per nflverse; he ran for another score Sunday, per ESPN's feed, and is 4th in EPA a dropback at 0.22.

James Cook keeps running. 421 yards, 3rd in the league, on 70 carries, 6.0 a carry, 2nd among backs with 40 or more, per nflverse, after 12 for 75 and a touchdown against New England, per ESPN's feed; Buffalo's 10 rushing touchdowns are the most, and the backfield ranks 1st in the tracker.

Greg Rousseau leads the league in sacks. 6 sacks, 16 QB hits and 3 forced fumbles, 1st, 1st and tied 1st, per nflverse; Buffalo gets 2.5 sacks a game, tied 8th, and pressures on 26.6 percent of dropbacks, 8th.

The receivers covered for DJ Moore. Keon Coleman caught 6 of 7 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown Sunday and Khalil Shakir 7 for 82, per ESPN's feed and nflverse; Dalton Kincaid leads the team with 270 yards on 15 catches.
weaknesses: DJ Moore's shoulder flared up again. matchup: Los Angeles is a 2.5 to 3 point home favorite. The deciding matchup is the Rams' line against Greg Rousseau. Los Angeles allows a sack on 3.6 percent of dropbacks, 3rd, and its line ranks 1st in the tracker; Rousseau leads the league with 6 sacks and 16 QB hits, per nflverse, and Buffalo pressures on 26.6 percent of dropbacks, 8th, against tackles Alaric Jackson and Warren McClendon Jr. on the Oct 7 depth chart.

Working against them is finishing drives. 417.0 yards a game, 2nd, but 21.3 points, 19th, and touchdowns on 53.3 percent of red zone trips, tied 21st; they needed two Kyren Williams touchdowns in the last 3:59 to win 24-20 at Philadelphia, and Buffalo scores 31.8 a game, 1st.
strengths: The pass defense is the league's best. 153.8 passing yards a game allowed, 1st, and 247.5 total yards, 2nd, per nflverse; 4.2 yards a play allowed, 2nd, and the secondary ranks 1st in the tracker with interceptions and passes defensed on 19.1 percent of dropbacks, 2nd.

The defense just smothered Philadelphia. The Eagles went 0 for 12 on third down with 172 total yards and 68 net passing yards and no points after halftime, per Yahoo, CBS and NBC Sports Philadelphia; Byron Young had 2.5 sacks, two on the final drive, per Eagles.com, PFT and CBS.

Puka Nacua is back. 9 catches for 125 yards and a 2 yard rushing touchdown in his return from a hip injury that cost him Weeks 2 and 3, per ESPN's feed and nflverse; Davante Adams has 22 catches for 390 yards, 5th in the league, and 2 touchdowns.

Kyren Williams carries the offense. 294 rushing yards at 5.4 a carry with 3 touchdowns, plus 21 catches for 173 yards, per nflverse; he scored from 4 and 7 yards in the last 3:59 to win at Philadelphia, per Eagles.com and PFT.

The line keeps Stafford clean. A sack on 3.6 percent of dropbacks, 3rd, and 1.5 sacks a game allowed, tied 5th, with the line 1st in the tracker; the offense gains 417.0 yards a game, 2nd, per nflverse.
weaknesses: Stafford is giving the ball away. 6 interceptions, tied for 2nd most behind Drake Maye's 7, per nflverse, including 2 with no touchdown passes in the 24-20 win, per ESPN's feed; the Rams have 8 giveaways and 3 takeaways, minus 1.3 a game, tied 27th.

The pass rush is thin without Garrett. 1.8 sacks a game, tied 22nd, and pressure on 23.1 percent of dropbacks, 15th; Byron Young has 3.5 of the team's 7 sacks, per nflverse, and Myles Garrett (knee surgery) is on injured reserve aiming for Week 6 against Arizona or Week 7 against Las Vegas, per Rapoport and Rams.com.

Donald and Watson are not cleared yet. Both were ruled out and sat Week 4, per nflverse, and ESPN's feed listed both out as of Tuesday; Sean McVay said Monday Aaron Donald (back) is trending toward playing and the Rams hope Jaylen Watson (dislocated shoulder) practices this week, per Rams.com, SI and the Orange County Register.

The tight ends and third receiver are hurt. Colby Parkinson (AC joint) is listed out and Terrance Ferguson (ankle) is on injured reserve, per ESPN's feed and nflverse, leaving Tyler Higbee (5 catches for 67 Sunday) and Davis Allen; Konata Mumpfield has a rotator cuff contusion, per the Orange County Register, and is questionable in ESPN's feed.

The kicking is shaky. Harrison Mevis is 5 of 7 on field goals, missing from 43 and 48, per nflverse, and went 1 for 2 at Philadelphia, per ESPN's feed; Buffalo's Tyler Bass is 6 of 6 in a game with a 54.5 total.
keys: Keep Josh Allen out of the end zone. Allen has 7 rushing touchdowns, tied for the league lead, and Buffalo 10, the most, per nflverse; the Rams have allowed 1 rushing touchdown, tied for 2nd fewest, so Nate Landman and Omar Speights have to hold at the goal line.

Throw at Buffalo's thinned cornerbacks. With Christian Benford (toe) listed out as of Tuesday and Dee Alford (ankle) hurt Sunday, Puka Nacua and Davante Adams draw rookie Davison Igbinosun and second year Maxwell Hairston; Buffalo allows 274.0 passing yards a game, 27th, per nflverse.

Run Kyren Williams and keep the ball. Buffalo is 32nd in rush EPA allowed with Ed Oliver (knee) hurt; Williams had 26 touches for 147 yards Sunday, and Matthew Stafford cannot add to 6 interceptions against Greg Rousseau, tied for the league lead with 3 forced fumbles.
